entries.title: Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___.
entries.text: Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___. [A] lack of imagination. 缺乏想象力。 [B] poor bargaining skill. 拙劣的谈判技巧。 [C] obsession with high fashion. 对高端时尚的痴迷。 [D] insensitivity to fashion. 答案 D Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ___.Priestly因为她的___而批评她的助手。 [A] lack of imagination.缺乏想象力。 [B] poor bargaining skill.拙劣的谈判技巧。 [C] obsession with high fashion.对高端时尚的痴迷。 [D] insensitivity to fashion. 💡 考场思路首段：scolds her assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her——助手以为高级时装跟自己无关。insensitivity to fashion = 对时尚不敏感。

entries.title: According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___.
entries.text: According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___. [A] combat unnecessary waste. 遏制不必要的浪费。 [B] shop for their garments more frequently. [C] resist the influence of advertisements. 抵制广告的影响。 [D] shut out the feverish fashion world. 将狂热的时尚界拒之门外。 答案 B According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ___.根据Cline的说法，大众市场标签敦促消费者___。 [A] combat unnecessary waste.遏制不必要的浪费。 [B] shop for their garments more frequently. [C] resist the influence of advertisements.抵制广告的影响。 [D] shut out the feverish fashion world.将狂热的时尚界拒之门外。 💡 考场思路第二段：renew their wardrobe every few weeks——每隔几周就更新衣橱，即更频繁地买衣服。

entries.title: The word "indictment" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.
entries.text: The word "indictment" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___. [A] accusation. [B] enthusiasm. 热情；热忱。 [C] indifference. 冷漠；漠不关心。 [D] tolerance. 宽容。 答案 A The word "indictment" (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.“起诉书”一词（第2段）的含义最接近___。 [A] accusation. [B] enthusiasm.热情；热忱。 [C] indifference.冷漠；漠不关心。 [D] tolerance.宽容。 💡 考场思路《Overdressed》这本书批判快时尚浪费、过度消耗资源，indictment = 控诉、谴责。

entries.title: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?
entries.text: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph? [A] Vanity has more often been found in idealists. 虚荣更多见于理想主义者。 [B] The fast-fashion industry ignores sustainability. 快时尚行业忽视可持续性。 [C] Pricing is vital to environment-friendly purchasing. [D] People are more interested in affordable garments. 人们对平价服装更感兴趣。 答案 C Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?从最后一段可以推断出以下哪项？ [A] Vanity has more often been found in idealists.虚荣更多见于理想主义者。 [B] The fast-fashion industry ignores sustainability.快时尚行业忽视可持续性。 [C] Pricing is vital to environment-friendly purchasing. [D] People are more interested in affordable garments.人们对平价服装更感兴趣。 💡 考场思路末句：people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to——人们只有在买不起（不买不行）时才会可持续购物。= 价格对环保消费至关重要。

entries.title: What is the subject of the text?
entries.text: What is the subject of the text? [A] Satire on an extravagant lifestyle. 对奢侈生活方式的讽刺。 [B] Challenge to a high-fashion myth. 对高级时装神话的挑战。 [C] Criticism of the fast-fashion industry. [D] Exposure of a mass-market secret. 大众市场秘密的曝光。 答案 C What is the subject of the text?本文的主题是什么？ [A] Satire on an extravagant lifestyle.对奢侈生活方式的讽刺。 [B] Challenge to a high-fashion myth.对高级时装神话的挑战。 [C] Criticism of the fast-fashion industry. [D] Exposure of a mass-market secret.大众市场秘密的曝光。 💡 考场思路全文围绕《Overdressed》对快时尚行业的批判展开：浪费、剥削劳工、破坏环境。 核心词汇 scold v. 斥责 indictment n. 控诉 disposable adj. 一次性的 hijack v. 劫持 inventory n. 库存 curb v. 控制 vanity n. 虚荣心 sustainable adj. 可持续的

entries.title: It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___.
entries.text: It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___. [A] lower their operational costs. 降低其运营成本。 [B] ease competition among themselves. 缓和彼此间的竞争。 [C] avoid complaints from consumers. 避免消费者的投诉。 [D] provide better online services. 答案 D It is suggested in Paragraph 1 that "behavioural" ads help advertisers to ___.第1款建议“行为”广告帮助广告商___。 [A] lower their operational costs.降低其运营成本。 [B] ease competition among themselves.缓和彼此间的竞争。 [C] avoid complaints from consumers.避免消费者的投诉。 [D] provide better online services. 💡 考场思路首段说一半广告预算浪费，行为广告通过精准投放把浪费减少——即广告更有效。结合后文"less targeted ads"是坏事，反推行为广告让广告更精准有效。

entries.title: "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___.
entries.text: "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___. [A] online advertisers. 在线广告商。 [B] e-commerce conductors. 电子商务的经营者。 [C] digital information analysts. 数字信息分析师。 [D] internet browser developers. 答案 D "The industry" (Para. 3) refers to ___.“行业” （第3段）是指___。 [A] online advertisers.在线广告商。 [B] e-commerce conductors.电子商务的经营者。 [C] digital information analysts.数字信息分析师。 [D] internet browser developers. 💡 考场思路第三段提到FTC提议在浏览器中加DNT，微软IE、苹果Safari、谷歌Chrome都跟进——the industry 指浏览器开发商。

entries.title: Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___.
entries.text: Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___. [A] goes against human nature. 违背人性。 [B] fails to affect the ad industry. 未能影响广告业。 [C] will not benefit consumers. [D] may cut the number of junk ads. 可能减少垃圾广告的数量。 答案 C Bob Liodice holds that setting DNT as a default ___.Bob Liodice认为将DNT设置为默认值___。 [A] goes against human nature.违背人性。 [B] fails to affect the ad industry.未能影响广告业。 [C] will not benefit consumers. [D] may cut the number of junk ads.可能减少垃圾广告的数量。 💡 考场思路第五段：consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information——消费者处境会更糟。= 不会让消费者受益。

entries.title: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6?
entries.text: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6? [A] Advertisers are willing to implement DNT. 广告商愿意实施“禁止追踪”（DNT）。 [B] DNT may not serve its intended purpose. [C] DNT is losing its popularity among consumers. DNT在消费者中正失去人气。 [D] Advertisers are obliged to offer behavioural ads. 广告主有义务提供行为广告。 答案 B Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 6?根据第6段，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Advertisers are willing to implement DNT.广告商愿意实施“禁止追踪”（DNT）。 [B] DNT may not serve its intended purpose. [C] DNT is losing its popularity among consumers.DNT在消费者中正失去人气。 [D] Advertisers are obliged to offer behavioural ads.广告主有义务提供行为广告。 💡 考场思路第六段：收到DNT信号不强制停止追踪，有些公司可能无视DNT照常追踪——即DNT达不到预期目的。

entries.title: The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___.
entries.text: The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___. [A] appreciation. 欣赏；感激。 [B] understanding. 理解；谅解。 [C] indulgence. 纵容；沉溺。 [D] skepticism. 怀疑；质疑态度。 答案 D The author's attitude towards what Brendon Lynch said in his blog is one of ___.作者对Brendon Lynch在他的博客中所说的话的态度是___之一。 [A] appreciation.欣赏；感激。 [B] understanding.理解；谅解。 [C] indulgence.纵容；沉溺。 [D] skepticism.怀疑；质疑态度。 💡 考场思路末句反问：Could it really be that simple?（事情真有这么简单吗？）——质疑林奇的说辞。 核心词汇 budget n. 预算 behavioural adj. 行为的 default n. 默认设置 oblige v. 强制 opt v. 选择 compliance n. 遵守 norm n. 规范 privacy n. 隐私

entries.title: Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___.
entries.text: Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___. [A] our desire for lives of fulfillment. 我们对充实生活的渴望。 [B] our faith in science and technology. [C] our awareness of potential risks. 我们对潜在风险的意识。 [D] our belief in equal opportunity. 我们对机会均等的信念。 答案 B Our vision of the future used to be inspired by ___.我们过去对未来的愿景曾受到___的启发。 [A] our desire for lives of fulfillment.我们对充实生活的渴望。 [B] our faith in science and technology. [C] our awareness of potential risks.我们对潜在风险的意识。 [D] our belief in equal opportunity.我们对机会均等的信念。 💡 考场思路首段：Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity——过去我们乐观是因为相信科技能解决一切。

entries.title: The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___.
entries.text: The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___. [A] a misplaced race. 一场错位之争。 [B] a sustained species. [C] the world's dominant power. 世界主导力量。 [D] a threat to the environment. 对环境的威胁。 答案 B The IUCN's "Red List" suggests that human beings are ___.世界自然保护联盟的“红色名录”表明，人类是___。 [A] a misplaced race.一场错位之争。 [B] a sustained species. [C] the world's dominant power.世界主导力量。 [D] a threat to the environment.对环境的威胁。 💡 考场思路红色名录把智人列为"无危"，分布广、适应强、数量仍在增长——说明人类是一个可持续存续的物种。

entries.title: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5?
entries.text: Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5? [A] The interest in science fiction is on the rise. 对科幻小说的兴趣正在上升。 [B] Arc helps limit the scope of futurological studies. Arc有助于限制未来学研究的范畴。 [C] Technology offers solutions to social problems. 技术为社会问题提供解决方案。 [D] Our immediate future is hard to conceive. 答案 D Which of the following is true according to Paragraph 5?根据第5段，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] The interest in science fiction is on the rise.对科幻小说的兴趣正在上升。 [B] Arc helps limit the scope of futurological studies.Arc有助于限制未来学研究的范畴。 [C] Technology offers solutions to social problems.技术为社会问题提供解决方案。 [D] Our immediate future is hard to conceive. 💡 考场思路第五段：当今技术演进及其社会后果复杂得令人眼花缭乱，最好留给科幻作家和未来学家——即近期未来很难设想。

entries.title: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___.
entries.text: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___. [A] draw on our experience from the past. [B] adopt an optimistic view of the world. 对世界持乐观看法。 [C] explore our planet's abundant resources. 开发我们星球丰富的资源。 [D] curb our ambition to reshape history. 遏制我们重塑历史的野心。 答案 A To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to ___.为了确保人类的未来，这对___至关重要。 [A] draw on our experience from the past. [B] adopt an optimistic view of the world.对世界持乐观看法。 [C] explore our planet's abundant resources.开发我们星球丰富的资源。 [D] curb our ambition to reshape history.遏制我们重塑历史的野心。 💡 考场思路第六段：the past holds the key to the future——过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙，要从过去的长期模式中吸取经验。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title of the text? [A] Uncertainty about Our Future 关于我们未来的不确定性 [B] Evolution of the Human Species 人类物种的演化 [C] The Ever-bright Prospects of Mankind [D] Science, Technology and Humanity 科学、技术与人文 答案 C Which of the following would be the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Uncertainty about Our Future关于我们未来的不确定性 [B] Evolution of the Human Species人类物种的演化 [C] The Ever-bright Prospects of Mankind [D] Science, Technology and Humanity科学、技术与人文 💡 考场思路全文反驳"人类未来悲观论"，论证从长时段看人类前景光明。C既点出mankind又点出乐观。 核心词汇 utopia n. 乌托邦 gloominess n. 悲观 endure v. 存续 adaptable adj. 适应性强的 futurologist n. 未来学家 envisage v. 设想 descendant n. 后代 passing fad 一时时髦

entries.title: Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___.
entries.text: Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___. [A] overstepped the authority of federal immigration law. 逾越了联邦移民法的权限。 [B] disturbed the power balance between different states. 扰乱了不同州之间的权力平衡。 [C] deprived the federal police of Constitutional powers. 剥夺了联邦警察的宪法权力。 [D] contradicted both the federal and state policies. 答案 D Three provisions of Arizona's plan were overturned because they ___.亚利桑那州计划的三项规定被推翻，因为它们___。 [A] overstepped the authority of federal immigration law.逾越了联邦移民法的权限。 [B] disturbed the power balance between different states.扰乱了不同州之间的权力平衡。 [C] deprived the federal police of Constitutional powers.剥夺了联邦警察的宪法权力。 [D] contradicted both the federal and state policies. 💡 考场思路亚利桑那州试图制定与联邦政策并行的州政策，侵犯联邦特权——即与联邦法律相抵触。

entries.title: On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4?
entries.text: On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4? [A] States' independence from federal immigration law. 各州对联邦移民法的独立性。 [B] Federal officers' duty to withhold immigrants' information. 联邦官员隐瞒移民信息的职责。 [C] States' legitimate role in immigration enforcement. [D] Congress's intervention in immigration enforcement. 国会对移民执法的干预。 答案 C On which of the following did the Justices agree, according to Paragraph 4?根据第4款，法官同意以下哪些内容？ [A] States' independence from federal immigration law.各州对联邦移民法的独立性。 [B] Federal officers' duty to withhold immigrants' information.联邦官员隐瞒移民信息的职责。 [C] States' legitimate role in immigration enforcement. [D] Congress's intervention in immigration enforcement.国会对移民执法的干预。 💡 考场思路第四段：大法官允许亚利桑那州警方核查接触执法者的合法身份，因为国会一直设想联邦与州联合执法——即承认州在移民执法中的合法角色。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___. [A] violated the Constitution. 违反了宪法。 [B] stood in favor of the states. [C] supported the federal statute. 支持该联邦法规。 [D] undermined the states' interests. 损害了各州的利益。 答案 B It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ___.从第5款可以推断，《外国人和煽动法》___。 [A] violated the Constitution.违反了宪法。 [B] stood in favor of the states. [C] supported the federal statute.支持该联邦法规。 [D] undermined the states' interests.损害了各州的利益。 💡 考场思路斯卡利亚为可追溯到《客籍法和惩治煽动叛乱法》的州权辩护——说明该法案支持州权。

entries.title: The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___.
entries.text: The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___. [A] outweighs that held by the states. [B] is established by federal statutes. 由联邦法规确立。 [C] is dependent on the states' support. 依赖于各州的支持。 [D] rarely goes against state laws. 很少违背州法律。 答案 A The White House claims that its power of enforcement ___.白宫声称其执法权力___。 [A] outweighs that held by the states. [B] is established by federal statutes.由联邦法规确立。 [C] is dependent on the states' support.依赖于各州的支持。 [D] rarely goes against state laws.很少违背州法律。 💡 考场思路第六段：白宫声称它可以废除任何它不认同的州法律——即白宫执法权凌驾于州之上。

entries.title: What can be learned from the last paragraph?
entries.text: What can be learned from the last paragraph? [A] Immigration issues are usually decided by Congress. 移民问题通常由国会决定。 [B] The Administration is dominant over immigration issues. 行政当局在移民问题上占主导。 [C] Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress. 大法官希望加强与国会的协调。 [D] Justices intended to check the power of the Administration. 答案 D What can be learned from the last paragraph?从最后一段可以学到什么？ [A] Immigration issues are usually decided by Congress.移民问题通常由国会决定。 [B] The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.行政当局在移民问题上占主导。 [C] Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress.大法官希望加强与国会的协调。 [D] Justices intended to check the power of the Administration. 💡 考场思路末句：Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim——所有大法官都驳回了白宫的主张，即大法官们意图制约政府权力。 核心词汇 overturn v. 推翻 precede v. 优先于 intrude v. 侵犯 verify v. 核查 contemplate v. 设想 robust adj. 强有力的 invalidate v. 使无效 exclusively adv. 排他地

entries.title: yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it
entries.text: yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression. yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression. 然而，只要看看无家可归者创造的花园的照片，你就会意识到：尽管样式各异，这些花园除了表达装饰和创造性表达之外，还传达着人类其他各种根本的渴望。 采分点① it strikes one that 人们突然意识到；② for all 尽管；③ diversity of styles 样式多样；④ speak of 传达。

entries.title: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as
entries.text: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need. A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need. 无论多么简陋，一片宁静的圣地是人类独有的需求，而庇护所则是动物独有的需求。 采分点① sacred place 圣地；② crude 简陋的；③ distinctly 独特地；④ as opposed to 与……相对。

entries.title: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce for
entries.text: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such. The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn't exist or was not discernible as such. 无家可归者的花园实际上就是无家之园，它们给城市环境引入了一种形式，这种形式要么原本不存在，要么无法被这样辨认出来。 采分点① in effect 实际上；② discernible 可辨认的；③ as such 照此本身。

entries.title: most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some
entries.text: most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic. most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic. 我们大多数人会陷入精神萎靡，通常将其归咎于某种心理状态，直到有一天我们置身花园，才会感觉烦闷感像变魔术一样消失了。 采分点① give in to 陷入/屈服于；② demoralization of spirit 精神萎靡；③ blame on 归咎于；④ as if by magic 像变魔术一样。

Before them lie four divergent paths labeled "job hunting," "pursuing postgraduate studies," "going abroad," and "starting a business." The caption reads simply: choice. The drawing captures a defining moment in every young person's life: upon graduation, we are suddenly confronted with a dizzying array of paths.
